x_extensibility_rule: Additive-only. Unknown fields tolerated by loaders. Reserved namespace: x_*. Field semantics frozen once shipped. Bump schema_version only on a breaking change; bump semantic_version on additive change.

bugs.title: Walker-emitter chicken-and-egg deadlock at the gate level (clean install)
bugs.repro: Boot the client on a clean install (no per-asset .pd<ext> content under data/<romid>/<kind>/). The 6 pool-dependent emitters (pdwpn, pdmesh, pdanim, pdhead, pdbody, pdarena) early-return on loaderPoolIsActive() which only flips true once the universal walker registers >= 1 file. On clean install the flag stays 0 and emitters never run.
bugs.x_notes: Mike's option (c) applied: gates removed, emitters run unconditionally. Inner loops handle NULL pool slots. Followup that BYOR Completion (Option B authoring tables) closed: empty-pool-on-clean-BYOR is no longer reachable because authoring tables drive emitters directly.

bugs.title: fsCreateDir return-value semantics inverted at 14 call sites
bugs.repro: Boot a build with existing data/<romid>/animations|fonts|lang|ui directories on disk. Pre-fix: four spurious LOUDFAIL.EXTRACT.* lines at startup ('fsCreateDir(...) failed') even though the directories exist.
bugs.x_notes: fsCreateDir returned raw _mkdir/mkdir int (0=success) but most callers used if (!fsCreateDir(x)) which interpreted SUCCESS as failure. Standardised on 1=success / 0=failure across all 14 + 12 raw-POSIX sites.

bugs.title: Audio emitter parent-dir creation missing on Windows (1545+119 failures)
bugs.repro: Fresh BYOR install; expect logs 'romextract pdsfx: written=0 skipped=0 failed=1545' and 'romextract pdsong: written=0 skipped=0 failed=119' with each fail emitting LOUDFAIL.EXTRACT.PDSFX.
bugs.x_notes: Windows _mkdir does not create intermediate directories. Each audio emitter now fsCreateDirs the audio/ parent before its leaf subdir. Followup: pdvoice skipped=1545 (every sound classified is_voice=0) is a separate russ-table read issue.

bugs.title: Install layout: nested data/data/ path on release
bugs.repro: Pre-fix release zip extracted to nested layout dist/v.../data/data/<romid>/ instead of dist/v.../data/<romid>/. Mike's pd-client.log line 'base dir: .../Perfect Dark 2.0/data' confirmed the doubled-up layout.
bugs.x_notes: DEFAULT_BASEDIR_NAME changed from 'data' to '.' so base dir = EXE directory. Trailing '/.' stripped at fsInit. release.ps1 data-copy loop refactored to use $DistDir directly.

bugs.title: Retire data/README.txt in favor of put_your_rom_here.txt at install root
bugs.repro: Pre-fix release zip shipped data/README.txt. Mike's directive: filename should be the call-to-action.
bugs.x_notes: put_your_rom_here.txt now sits at install root; content covers ROM placement, region/format, first-launch, troubleshooting, install layout.

bugs.title: Post-boot AV in challengesInit: N64-vs-PC mpconfig/mpstrings stride mismatch
bugs.repro: Launch any post-Pass-C build (dev b15cc701+). AV at boot inside bcopy/memcpy+146 from a dmaExecWithAutoAlign over-read at src/game/challenge.c:410 (pre-fix). Last log line 'VERBOSE: INIT: challengesInit...'. AV in first iteration.
bugs.x_notes: PC MAX_BOTS grew 8 -> 32. sizeof(struct mpconfig) and sizeof(struct mpstrings) grew. On-disk segment uses N64 stride. PC code used PC sizeof for both stride AND read length, walking 60 KB past segment end. Fix: remove mpconfigs dmaExec (dead read overwritten by g_MpConfigs assignment); replace mpstrings dmaExec with N64-sized 320-byte chunk bcopy at N64-spaced offsets, with bzero of the whole PC struct first.

bugs.title: AV at boot in bgunCalculateBlend (weapon NULL via empty loader pool)
bugs.repro: Launch fresh build of dev 232d05ea (post-BYOR + post-pivot triage + B-323 fix). AV at 'setupCreateProps done, calling reset functions'. Stack: bgunCalculateBlend (bondgun.c:3526) -> bgunReset -> lvReset -> mainLoop -> mainProc -> main. weaponFindById(0) returned NULL.
bugs.x_notes: Caused by B-325. Walker ran BEFORE emitters on clean install, registered 0 entries, s_LoaderActive stayed 0, loaderPoolGetWeapon returned NULL for every index for the entire boot. Fix is structural via B-325 reorder; no defensive NULL check added at AV site (would silence the symptom without fixing the structural deadlock).

bugs.title: Walker ran before emitters in bootRunCatalogWork (structural deadlock)
bugs.repro: Clean-install boot of dev 232d05ea. Mike's pd-client.log: 'LOADER.UNIVERSAL.SUMMARY: scanned=0 registered=0 envelope_failures=0 register_failures=0 active=0' at 00:05.43, then 'romextract pdwpn: written=86' at 00:05.47. Loader pool never activates; all weapon access returns NULL for the rest of boot.
bugs.x_notes: Fix: reordered boot phases so all 13 emitters run BEFORE BOOT_PHASE_WALKER. Walker block now sits between BOOT_PHASE_EMIT_UI and BOOT_PHASE_BUILD_CACHES. Boot progress accumulator is order-independent (completed_mask bitmask). Phase 5 weight caching unaffected.

bugs.title: Dev Window v2 + build-headless place pd.<romid>.z64 in data/ instead of install root
bugs.repro: Trigger Dev Window v2 build OR build-headless.ps1 build. Pre-fix: pd.<romid>.z64 ends up at <BuildDir>\data\ instead of <BuildDir>\. Post B-321 (DEFAULT_BASEDIR_NAME = '.') the binary searches install root for the ROM.
bugs.x_notes: Both scripts now sweep ..\post-batch-addin\data\*.z64 to <BuildDir>\ first, then mirror the rest of data\ to <BuildDir>\data\ with *.z64 excluded (robocopy /XF '*.z64'). release.ps1 was already correct.
